item.title: Beetham’s Botanicals
item.description: Simply, the term endangered relates to any plant that lives in a threatened natural habitat that is still needing preservation or has indeed been lost. The IUCN (International Union for Conservation of Nature) has established a public access database that lists not only plant species but animals as well, with categories that range (in the case of this article) from endangered to critically endangered to extinct in the wild.
